summary: All 8 acceptance_matrix criteria covered with 2 backend test files and 9 browser checks. All passed.

checks.name: test_tscheck_quote_submission.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/quotes with valid tscheck payload -> 201, body has id/status=novo; POST with invalid name/phone/vehicle -> 422

checks.criterion: Admin login, CRUD battery and vehicle, toggle validation, quote status change, logout
checks.name: test_tscheck_admin_crud_and_auth.py
checks.evidence: POST /auth/login wrong password -> 401; correct login -> 200 + GET /auth/me 200; GET /admin/batteries without cookie -> 401; battery POST/PUT/DELETE on tscheck-batt-001 -> 201/200/200 and removed from list after delete; vehicle POST -> 201 validated=false, PUT validated=true -> 200, GET /finder/result/{id} shows validated=true, DELETE -> 200; quote PATCH status -> em_atendimento reflected in GET /admin/quotes

checks.criterion: Home page renders hero, finder, services, differentials, area+quote form, reviews, FAQ, footer with working WhatsApp/tel links
checks.name: home-page-sections-and-links
checks.evidence: hero-title, battery-finder, area-neighborhoods, quote-form, reviews-count, footer-whatsapp-link all visible; floating-whatsapp-button href contains wa.me/5521999404005?text=...; hero-call-link href = tel:+5521999404005

checks.criterion: Finder search by name with autocomplete (keyboard arrows + Enter)
checks.name: finder-search-autocomplete
checks.evidence: Typed 'onix' -> finder-search-results shows Onix entries; ArrowDown+Enter navigated to /encontre-sua-bateria?v=<id> with finder-result visible

checks.criterion: Finder cascade make -> model -> year -> version, popular chips prefill make/model, result specs/pending badge/alternatives, Alterar veículo returns to finder form
checks.name: finder-cascade-and-result
checks.evidence: Jeep/Compass/2023 -> finder-versions -> selected version 0 -> result-vehicle-name contains Compass, result-vehicle-spec/result-pending-validation-badge/result-battery-card-0/result-alternatives-note visible; result-change-vehicle-top-button returns to popular-list view; popular chip 'finder-popular-compass' prefills make=Jeep, model=Compass

checks.criterion: Result WhatsApp button contains vehicle, year, Start-Stop, battery code
checks.name: result-whatsapp-and-specs
checks.evidence: result-whatsapp-button-0 href decoded contains 'Compass', '2023', 'start-stop' (case-insensitive) and battery code matching /REF-/

checks.name: quote-form-validation-and-submit
checks.evidence: Empty submit shows quote-name-error/quote-phone-error; valid submit triggers POST /api/quotes -> 201, quote-success panel + quote-success-whatsapp-link visible

checks.criterion: Admin login, CRUD battery, logout, wrong password error (UI)
checks.name: admin-login-crud-and-logout
checks.evidence: Wrong password shows admin-login-error; correct login shows admin-user-email; created/edited/deleted battery row admin-battery-row-<code> (ah 55->70->removed); logout returns to admin-login-form

checks.criterion: Admin vehicle CRUD + validation toggle reflected on public result
checks.name: admin-vehicle-crud-and-validation-toggle
checks.evidence: Created tscheck vehicle, toggled validate button text to 'Validada', public /encontre-sua-bateria?v=<id> shows result-validated-badge; vehicle deleted afterwards

checks.criterion: Quote appears in admin Pedidos tab and status can be changed
checks.name: admin-quote-status-and-inbox
checks.evidence: Submitted quote via public form with unique tscheck name; admin-quotes-table shows the row; admin-quote-status-select changed to em_atendimento and value persisted

checks.criterion: Mobile 390px: no horizontal scroll, mobile menu opens and links navigate
checks.name: mobile-no-horizontal-scroll-and-menu
checks.evidence: scrollWidth <= clientWidth+2 at 390px viewport; mobile-menu-button opens sheet, mobile-nav-servicos-link navigates to service-item-0 section; floating-whatsapp-button bounding box present

checks.criterion: 404 route and SEO assets (robots.txt, sitemap.xml) via public preview URL
checks.name: 404-route-and-seo-assets
checks.evidence: Ran against https://express-baterias-rio.preview.emergentagent.com/xyz -> not-found-page visible; GET /robots.txt -> 200; GET /sitemap.xml -> 200
